ATUM_ENV.description: stub runs a demo that moves no funds. testnet or mainnet settle real tips through Atum.

DEST_ADDRESS.description: The 0x address that receives your tips. Required unless ATUM_ENV is stub.

DEST_ASSET.description: The token you receive, as a CAIP-19 id from https://docs.atum.xyz/get-started/reference/supported-assets. Required on mainnet.

SOURCE_ASSETS.description: Comma-separated CAIP-19 ids of the tokens payers may pay with. Leave empty for the default.

AUTHOR_NAME.description: Your name, shown on the tip page.

TIP_MESSAGE.value: If this helped, please consider supporting the author.

TIP_AMOUNTS.description: The tip menu, in units of the token you receive.

MARKUP_BPS.description: How far the payer's spend cap may exceed the tip, in basis points. At most 500.
